pages.title: Mae Hong Son
pages.description: town in Mae Hong Son province, Thailand
pages.extract: Mae Hong Son (Thai: แม่ฮ่องสอน) is a city (pop. 7,000) in Mae Hong Son Province, Northern Thailand.

pages.title: Mexico State
pages.extract: Mexico State (Spanish: Estado de México), often referred to locally as Edomex, is one of the country's 31 states. It surrounds Mexico City on three sides. The state has several densely populated suburban municipalities near the city, but becomes very rural further away with the western part of the state being particularly mountainous as the peaks of the Sierra Madre dominate the landscape with volcanoes, forests, and small towns. To the northwest of Mexico City is the Valley of Mexico, an industrial engine of Central Mexico.

pages.title: Mont-de-Marsan
pages.description: French commune in Landes, Aquitaine, New Aquitaine
pages.extract: Mont-de-Marsan is a commune and capital of the Landes department in Aquitaine in southwestern France.

pages.title: Nosara
pages.description: district in Nicoya canton, Guanacaste province, Costa Rica
pages.extract: Nosara is a city in Guanacaste, Costa Rica.  This town has access to several great beaches and retains "Blue Flag" status as an environmentally clean area. Nosara has become increasingly popular with tourists over the years – perhaps to its detriment, depending on your point of view – as evidenced by the numerous organic smoothie bars and wellness centers dotted along its main road.

pages.title: Pahang
pages.extract: Pahang is the third largest state in area in Malaysia and largest in Peninsular Malaysia. It is considered an East Coast state and has a long coast, including Tioman island, the largest on the East Coast, but it also goes inland quite a ways and includes much of Taman Negara, Peninsular Malaysia's famous rainforest park, and also the Cameron Highlands and Genting Highlands, which are closer to the Straits of Malacca than to the South China Sea. With its varied terrain and a diverse population, Pahang is an interesting state to visit.

pages.title: Southeastern Anatolia
pages.extract: Southeastern Anatolia (Turkish: Güneydoğu Anadolu), is a region in the south east of Turkey. It borders Syria to the south and Iraq to the southeast, and forms part of the majority Kurdish-inhabited area known as Kurdistan.

pages.title: Woqooyi Galbeed
pages.extract: Woqooyi Galbeed, sometimes known as Maroodi Jeex, is one of the administrative regions of  Somaliland. Containing Somaliland's capital and two largest cities, it forms the most populous and important region in the country. It also houses the largest number of attractions and sights when compared to the rest of Somaliland.

pages.title: Cumberland Falls State Resort Park
pages.description: park located in the Daniel Boone National Forest, Kentucky, United States
pages.extract: Cumberland Falls State Resort Park is a state park in Kentucky's Daniel Boone Country, within the Daniel Boone National Forest.

pages.title: Albacete
pages.extract: Albacete is a city and municipality of 173,000 people (2018) in Castile-La Mancha. Albacete has a reputation as producer of clasp knives.

pages.title: Margate (Tasmania)
pages.extract:
Margate is a town of 4,239 (2021) in the Greater Hobart region in southern Tasmania, and is one of the northernmost towns along the D'Entrecasteux Channel. The town is eight kilometers southwest of Kingston and 20 km from Hobart, the state capital.
The town is home to the Channel Museum, which is one of the few remnants of Margate's historic past as much of the town was burned in the 1967 bushfires. Another historical remnant is the Margate Train (depicted in banner), which is a train that contains various retail businesses within its carriages.

pages.title: Volcan Nevado de Colima National Park
pages.extract: Volcan Nevado de Colima National Park  is a large national park that protects a twin stratovolcano complex on the Pacific Coast of Mexico in the states of Colima and Jalisco (most of the accessible areas are in Jalisco). The two volcanoes encompassed in the park are Volcan de Colima (also called Volcan de Fuego) and Nevado de Colima. The park is a good choice for hiking, backpacking, camping, and mountaineering.

pages.title: Ezeagu Tourist Complex
pages.extract: Ezeagu Tourist Complex is in Obinofia Ndiuno of Udi Local Government Area of Enugu State, Nigeria. The complex is made up of a waterfall, a natural spring and lake, and a cave (full of tunnels and chambers) which is about 3 km distant from the waterfall.

pages.title: Chiranci
pages.description: LGA and town in Katsina State, Nigeria
pages.extract: Chiranci or Charanchi is in Katsina State in Northern Nigeria. It is rich in Hausa-Fulani culture, language, and traditions. Chiranci is known for its local markets, traditional crafts, and welcoming communities, and offers a glimpse into the rural lifestyle in Nigeria.
